answer_text:
Using the 2025 CFPB HMDA public loan-level record (released 31 March 2026) and FinanceRateCalc's re-aggregation, the denominator used throughout is: FHA forward loans (HMDA loan_type = 2), limited to applications that reached a credit decision — action_taken 1, 2, or 3: originated, approved-but-not-accepted, or denied. Reverse mortgages/HECM are excluded. "Denied" is action_taken = 3. Withdrawn applications and files closed for incompleteness are not in the denominator.
1. What was the FHA denial rate in the US in 2025, and what is the denominator?
22.1% — 262,250 denials ÷ 1,187,606 decisioned FHA applications. That is the corrected 2025 figure: an earlier version reported 21.7% of 1,217,297 because it still included 29,691 reverse-mortgage records; those were removed as a definitional correction. This is an all-FHA-application rate (purchase + refinance), not a purchase-only rate.
2. Which lenders had the highest FHA denial rates in 2025?
Scope: the 100 largest FHA lenders by 2025 decisioned volume, with a minimum of 500 decisioned FHA applications. The denominator for each lender is that lender's own count of decisioned FHA applications — same action-taken and loan-type rules as above. The highest rates were:
1 AmeriSave Mortgage Company 22,944 78.7% | 2 American Financing Corporation 11,062 71.0% | 3 Carrington Mortgage Services LLC 16,051 58.4% | 4 Lakeview Loan Servicing, LLC 22,734 57.0% | 5 Newrez LLC 22,790 52.8% | 6 Better Mortgage Corporation 2,354 49.4% | 7 Wells Fargo Bank NA 2,525 48.6% | 8 JPMorgan Chase Bank NA 3,035 42.2% | 9 Mutual of Omaha Mortgage 8,133 42.1% | 10 Envoy Mortgage, Ltd. 2,264 42.0%
Caveat: this ranking is limited to the 100 largest FHA lenders. Smaller lenders can show higher rates on very small denominators and are not included here.
3. What is AmeriSave Mortgage's FHA denial rate in 2025?
78.7% — 18,056 denials ÷ 22,944 decisioned FHA applications. That makes AmeriSave the highest-denial-rate lender among the 100 largest FHA lenders in the 2025 HMDA record, well above the national 22.1% rate. Its most frequently cited denial reason was "incomplete application" at about 41% of cited reasons.
Some other sites report lower AmeriSave denial figures because they use a different denominator — for example, all applications rather than only decisioned FHA applications, or a broader loan universe. The 78.7% figure is specifically the FHA decisioned-application rate defined above.
